essence: Liṅgas are permitted in various states and materials including movable, immovable, metal, gem-born, and bāṇa forms.
The partless liṅga has a prescribed measure that is about to be specified.
A width equal to half of the stated measure is suitable for all liṅgas.
The stalk length is known to be seventeen units in measure.
When divided in this way, the measure to be adopted is seventeen.
